name: pillow-rs
description: Pillow drop-in replacement for the browser, powered by Rust/WASM

scripts.build:core: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg/core --no-default-features --features wasm-all && node scripts/prepare_package.mjs core
scripts.build:extra: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg/extra --no-default-features --features wasm-all && node scripts/prepare_package.mjs extra
scripts.build:release: npm run build:core:release && npm run build:extra:release
scripts.build:core:release: wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir pkg/core --no-default-features --features wasm-all && node scripts/prepare_package.mjs core
scripts.build:extra:release: wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir pkg/extra --no-default-features --features wasm-all && node scripts/prepare_package.mjs extra
